data.summary: Techno-functional Business Analyst / Project Manager with 20+ years of BFSI experience delivering global transformation initiatives across Investment Banking, Capital Markets, Fund Administration, Asset Management and Alternative Investments. Proven expertise in leading end-to-end SDLC delivery from business case, requirements gathering, BRDs, FRDs, functional specifications, workflow modelling, solution design, SIT, UAT, implementation and production support. Extensive knowledge of Trade Lifecycle, FX, OTC Derivatives, Regulatory Reporting, Digital Transformation, Workflow Automation, Agile and Waterfall methodologies.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Associate Director (Product Owner) | Aithon Solutions | Apr 2025 – Nov 2025 •
Led requirements workshops for AI-powered NAV Oversight platform for Alternative Investment Funds. Prepared BRDs, FRDs, user stories, workflow diagrams and acceptance criteria. Partnered with Technology to design automation solutions and supported UAT and implementation.
•
Vice President (Techno Functional BA) | BNY Mellon | Jul 2023 – Apr 2025 • Led end-to-end delivery of SEC NMFP, NCEN and NPORT regulatory reporting projects. • Managed requirements, solution design, SIT/UAT coordination, issue tracking and production

implementation. Collaborated with Operations, Finance, Technology and global stakeholders to deliver automation initiatives reducing manual effort by 30%.
Senior Consultant (Product Owner) | WNS Global Services | May 2021 – Jun 2023 • Delivered workflow automation products for AP and AR teams. • Managed backlog, requirements, Agile ceremonies and stakeholder communication. •
Implemented reporting dashboards and process optimisation initiatives reducing manual effort by 60%.
AVP – Investment Banking Technology | J.P. Morgan Chase | Mar 2017 – May 2021 • Led medium-to-large migration programmes across LATAM, EMEA and APAC. • Produced BRDs, FRDs, process flows, functional specifications and data mappings. • Managed trade lifecycle, settlement and MTM accounting initiatives for FX products. •
Coordinated SIT, UAT, defect management and business sign-offs with Front Office, Operations, Finance and Technology teams.
AVP – Alternative Investments Technology | J.P. Morgan Chase | Jun 2011 – Feb 2017 • Delivered regulatory reporting and digital transformation initiatives including MMIF and AIFMD


reporting. Implemented workflow re-engineering, NAV automation, PCO enhancements and HedgeTek automation. Led global stakeholder discussions, requirements gathering and implementation across hedge fund platforms.

GAAP.

Prepared financial statements, MIS, regulatory reporting and coordinated statutory audits.
